WITH q1_fy2025_26 AS (
  SELECT MIN(calendar_date) as q_start, MAX(calendar_date) as q_end
  FROM dim_date
  WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND fiscal_quarter = 1
),
garden_products AS (
  SELECT product_key, sku, product_name, subcategory
  FROM dim_product
  WHERE category = 'Garden' AND is_current = true
),
sales_q1 AS (
  SELECT 
    gp.subcategory,
    fsl.product_key,
    SUM(fsl.quantity) as units_sold
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  INNER JOIN garden_products gp ON fsl.product_key = gp.product_key
  INNER JOIN q1_fy2025_26 q1 ON fsl.sale_date >= q1.q_start AND fsl.sale_date <= q1.q_end
  GROUP BY gp.subcategory, fsl.product_key
),
returns_for_q1_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    gp.subcategory,
    frl.product_key,
    SUM(frl.quantity_returned) as units_returned
  FROM fact_return_line frl
  INNER JOIN garden_products gp ON frl.product_key = gp.product_key
  INNER JOIN fact_sales_line fsl ON frl.sales_line_id = fsl.sales_line_id
  INNER JOIN q1_fy2025_26 q1 ON fsl.sale_date >= q1.q_start AND fsl.sale_date <= q1.q_end
  GROUP BY gp.subcategory, frl.product_key
)
SELECT 
  s.subcategory,
  s.units_sold,
  COALESCE(r.units_returned, 0) as units_returned,
  ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(r.units_returned, 0) / s.units_sold, 2) as return_rate_pct
FROM sales_q1 s
LEFT JOIN returns_for_q1_sales r ON s.subcategory = r.subcategory AND s.product_key = r.product_key
ORDER BY s.subcategory

WITH q1_fy2025_26 AS (
  SELECT MIN(calendar_date) as q_start, MAX(calendar_date) as q_end
  FROM dim_date
  WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND fiscal_quarter = 1
),
sales_q1 AS (
  SELECT 
    dp.subcategory,
    fsl.sales_line_id,
    fsl.quantity
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
  INNER JOIN q1_fy2025_26 q1 ON fsl.sale_date >= q1.q_start AND fsl.sale_date <= q1.q_end
  WHERE dp.category = 'Garden' AND dp.is_current = true
),
returns_for_q1_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    sq.subcategory,
    SUM(frl.quantity_returned) as total_units_returned
  FROM sales_q1 sq
  INNER JOIN fact_return_line frl ON sq.sales_line_id = frl.sales_line_id
  GROUP BY sq.subcategory
),
sales_aggregated AS (
  SELECT 
    subcategory,
    SUM(quantity) as total_units_sold
  FROM sales_q1
  GROUP BY subcategory
)
SELECT 
  sa.subcategory,
  sa.total_units_sold,
  COALESCE(rfq.total_units_returned, 0) as total_units_returned,
  ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(rfq.total_units_returned, 0) / sa.total_units_sold, 2) as return_rate_pct
FROM sales_aggregated sa
LEFT JOIN returns_for_q1_sales rfq ON sa.subcategory = rfq.subcategory
ORDER BY sa.subcategory
